title: Video processing
description: Prefer source captions; recognize locally when unavailable. Keep the original media.
empty: Choose a download or import a local file
emptyHint: Choose a download above, or use “Import video or audio” at the top right.
offline: Audio stays on this computer. Model downloads require an internet connection.
speaker: Speaker
needModel: Download the selected model to continue automatically.
name: Name or display label
languageHint: For example zh, en, ja, ko, fr. Prefer human captions, then platform automatic captions for each language. ASR does not translate.
automaticHint: New downloads created in editing mode only. Existing captions are reused without recognition.
attachHint: The download page saves available platform captions as files; it does not download models or start recognition.
metadata: Embed title, artist and available metadata
templateHint: Use {title}, {id}, {channel}, {artist}, {date}; leave blank for the preset. A task id prevents filename collisions.
kernelHint: Check official stable releases daily. Verified updates apply to new tasks; failures keep the current kernel. Rollback is available.
sizeHint: Model sizes are estimates. Archives may include extra files and require a larger download.
playbackError: This format cannot be previewed here. You can still process subtitles; videos can be exported to MP4 for playback.
noAvailableMedia: No media available; download or import a file
chooseHint: Select a completed video or audio download to load it for subtitle processing, or import a local file. Missing files are excluded.
mediaUnavailable: The downloaded media is missing or unreadable. Download it again or import a local file.
